events.text: Stable document-handle foundation implemented: topology and quality replacements retain the initial document key, advance a host-only generation, and update one retained geometry cache entry rather than minting per-op keys/entries. Generation now rides topology receipts and hot-reload session percepts. Added a pure stable_geometry_slot allocation policy with Zig tests. Verified test-stable-geometry-slot, test-mesh-edit, and ReleaseFast editor ship.

Implemented the semantic-memory + first live Agent Seat vertical slice: inheriting per-face region/instance ids across indexed splits, bevels, extrusion, duplicate, path-array, hide/show, glass reorder and journal restores; atomic RJMD v4 face rows + versioned name/provenance table; cold percept; strict cube pre-naming; native geometry/name selectors; exact arbitrary-axis transforms with explicit pivots; named extrusion cap/wall roles; naming-debt gate; live NOTICE transport with generation rejection and visible 100ms batch cadence; tools/seat CLI; portable validated agent-seat skill. Zig semantic/mesh/stable-handle tests, 12 RJMD tests, 4 seat API tests, skill validation, and ReleaseFast editor ship are green.

USER VISUAL PASS: supplied three live-editor screenshots proving tools/seat look atomically bootstraps six named cube sides with zero unnamed debt; select top resolves exactly 2 faces and highlights the intended surface; extrude 0.5 roof visibly creates the raised volume and percept regions roof.cap (2 faces) + roof.wall (8 faces); undo visibly restores the original cube and 12-face semantic percept. Core seat vertical slice is visually verified.

FIRST FULL SKILL TEST PASS (user screenshot): an agent built a recognizable detailed radio entirely through resident seat verbs from the unit cube, reaching 132 faces, 22 named regions, and zero naming debt. Semantic regions cover cabinet panels, grille, mirrored knobs, deck, dial, antenna, hatch, and base. The test surfaced the next concrete limitation: without atomic inset/subdivision/loop-cut role emission, each flat source face supports only one clean feature chain, forcing later features onto newly-created surfaces and producing avoidable stacked topology. Prioritize the remaining named structural ops before cosmetic UI work.
